title: One Hundred Concepts and Antimatter by FLUX Introduce the Missile Switch - The Outdoor Wire
excerpt: One Hundred Concepts and Antimatter by FLUX launched the Missile Switch, a mechanical safety cover for tactical lights designed to prevent accidental activation. Available for Modlite ModButton pressure pads and compatible SureFire and Modlite tailcaps, the product is designed and made in America.
content:
One Hundred Concepts and Antimatter by FLUX introduce the Missile Switch, a mechanical safety cover designed to help prevent accidental white-light activation. Designed and made in America, the lineup includes versions for Modlite ModButton™ pressure pads and compatible SureFire™ and Modlite™ click-style tailcaps.

Unintended pressure on a light switch can cause activation during handling, movement, or everyday carry. The Missile Switch adds a deliberate physical control, giving users greater control over when their light can activate while retaining the familiar operation of the existing switch.

The Missile Switch for Modlite ModButton™ integrates directly with compatible ModButton pressure pads, adding a positive mechanical on/off safety while preserving the pressure pad's familiar activation and ergonomics. Its simple, intuitive operation is designed for quick, deliberate manipulation.

The lineup also includes Missile Switch tailcap covers for compatible SureFire™ and Modlite™ click-style tailcaps. These versions install directly onto the compatible tailcap with a simple snap-fit design, adding a mechanical safety while maintaining the tailcap's existing functionality.

Beyond weapon-mounted applications, the tailcap versions support compatible handheld EDC and patrol lights, helping prevent accidental activation in a pocket or during routine carry.

The Missile Switch lineup includes:

  • Modlite ModButton™ version: Mechanical safety cover for compatible ModButton pressure pads.
  • SureFire™ tailcap version: Snap-fit safety cover for compatible SureFire click-style tailcaps.
  • Modlite™ tailcap version: Snap-fit safety cover for compatible Modlite click-style tailcaps.

FLUX fully supports collaboration across the firearms industry. We see its future as a healthy ecosystem of brands working together, sharing expertise, and building products that complement one another. Independent companies bring different strengths and perspectives, and collaboration creates opportunities to solve problems that any one brand might not solve alone. The Missile Switch reflects that belief: bring good people and ideas together, build something useful, and help the industry move forward.

Across all three versions, the purpose remains the same: make light activation a deliberate decision.

Designed and made in America.
